$comment: Single source of truth for file ownership. Read by sync.mjs, vendor.mjs, doctor.mjs and the docs. Paths are repo-relative globs. A path that matches no layer is treated as project-owned.

agentic.description: Owned by this template. sync.mjs may overwrite these paths in a spawned project.

vendored.description: Owned by an upstream project and pinned in vendor.json. Updated only with vendor.mjs, never edited in place. Customisations go in _bmad/custom.

project.description: Owned by the spawned project. Never touched by sync.
project.seededComment: Copied once at spawn time, then owned by the project. Sync never overwrites them.
